thesis: The reported financial snapshot is concerning, while launch/Neutron headlines and the 5/20-bar rebound are only prospective; price remains below SMA-200 and period dates are unavailable.
strongest_counterexample: The strongest counterexample is successful mission execution and Neutron progress converting into higher-margin recurring revenue while short-term momentum continues to repair.
invalidation_conditions: A close below the observed 60-bar low would weaken the rebound case.
evidence_gaps: Launch outcomes and Neutron timing are not confirmed in the packet.
Financial statement period and cash-runway trajectory are missing.
decisive_factors: Reported net income and FCF are negative.
5/20-bar returns are positive, but 60-bar return is -28.26% and price is below SMA-200.
